body.body:
Every command starts with the mention, one per line: `@lumenfx-bot <command>`. A bare word such as `ready` does nothing.

- `@lumenfx-bot help` (pull request, issue; anyone): Replies with this list.
- `@lumenfx-bot ready` (pull request; author, maintainer): Marks requested changes as addressed and moves the pull request back to review. `review` is an alias.
- `@lumenfx-bot author` (pull request; maintainer): Puts the pull request on the author until their next push or their `ready` command.
- `@lumenfx-bot blocked [#N]` (pull request, issue; maintainer): Adds the blocked label. With #N, the bot removes it when #N closes.
- `@lumenfx-bot unblock` (pull request, issue; maintainer): Removes the blocked label.
- `@lumenfx-bot label +NAME -NAME ...` (pull request, issue; maintainer; anyone for the labels the repository opens to everyone): Adds and removes labels. Quote names with spaces: +"good first issue".
- `@lumenfx-bot concern NAME` (pull request; maintainer): Raises a named concern; the pull request does not move to review while one is open.
- `@lumenfx-bot resolve NAME` (pull request; maintainer): Resolves a concern.
- `@lumenfx-bot no-docs-needed` (pull request; maintainer): Silences the docs advisory for this pull request.

Commands inside code, quotes, or HTML are ignored. The full list is at https://bot.lumenfx.dev/help.
